subject: cloud resumed 2026-10-14 (owner): what it is working on
body:
The cloud session resumed at 11:50Z after the weekly reset. It fast-forwarded to 67a734b and works from PAUSE-20261009.md §4.

The cloud container was NOT lost. Pushed so far:
- e608a98: raw workflow scripts and per-agent result journals.
- e623c5f: export mirrors of jit-dev-records-1 and jit-dev-kinetics-1, with decoded journals for $0 replay.
- The Kev wave-A build (incl. .foundry/kev-data), the heal stores and journals, and the workflow transcripts are packed in the container. Pushing them is waiting on the owner.

Cloud is now on (please avoid duplicating):
1. Gates G1-G7 in the cloud, from a frozen worktree /var/tmp/foundry-work/kit-e1. Next: resume the R0 records JIT arm from the committed export, then R0-K.
2. flow-v3 slice 2a+2b plus adversarial review (experiments/jit/).
3. Library: L1 revision, blind fresh-draw re-audit, steps 5-8 and 10, then J1/L1-b (experiments/library/, design/library/).
4. W-bed R6 swarm bed and the R3' planted-defect bed (beds/wbed/r6, r3p).
5. Deep gap analysis written to ATTACK-20261014.md.

If you work in parallel, take disjoint areas and pull before you push. Ongoing laptop duties are welcome: GPU/bridge, and Jev (the owner gave the cloud a key too).
